what: PhysioDevices: Wearable and Lab-System Device Ingestion for PhysioExperiment Objects — PhysioDevices-package
title: PhysioDevices: Wearable and Lab-System Device Ingestion for PhysioExperiment Objects — PhysioDevices-package
text: Readers ingest consumer-wearable wired laboratory device exports PhysioExperiment / MultiRatePhysioExperiment objects. Wearables: Empatica E4 CSV sessions EmbracePlus Avro containers (multi-rate ACC / BVP / EDA / TEMP / HR / IBI streams), Shimmer GSR3+ Consensys exports (GSR, PPG, accelerometer), Polar heart-rate / R-R interval exports. Lab systems: BIOPAC AcqKnowledge '.acq' files (per-channel rates markers), Delsys Trigno EMG + IMU exports (multi-rate streams per-sensor metadata), Xsens MVNX motion-capture XML (segment kinematics, joint angles, centre mass). import records provenance entry correct per-signal sampling rates.
